entries.back_en: You lost a Valkyrie. It never happened before. They don't want more risks leaving you here.
entries.note: Sentido preservado; ligeiramente compacto mas fiel.

entries.back_en: What if Yggdrasil is discovered? Planting it violated the agreement.
Once planted, Yggdrasil sustains the world's foundations until it dies, causing an explosion so colossal it takes the entire planet with it.
If you want to save your friends' lives and everyone's, you'll have to stop him before he reaches Yggdrasil's roots.
They're not taking any risk. The unknown plague put the superiors on alert.
entries.note: 'on edge' como 'em alerta' é aceitável; leve mudança de nuance (tensão vs. alerta).
